subject.title: System prompt: add guidance for spawning background sub-agents

question: Should this PR be rebased and consolidated into the existing sub-agent prompt/tool-description surfaces, or should maintainers close it because current main and v2026.6.11 already cover the central guidance?
rationale: Current main already ships overlapping prompt guidance and supports configured nested spawning, while this PR adds a duplicate rubric and contradictory nesting policy; the remaining choice is prompt-policy direction, not a mechanical repair.

options.title: Rebase And Consolidate Guidance
options.body: Keep only useful non-duplicative examples and merge them into the existing availability-aware and depth-aware prompt/tool-description surfaces.

options.title: Close As Covered
options.body: Treat the current-main and v2026.6.11 guidance as sufficient and close this stale branch without merging another prompt-policy source.

options.title: Change Nested Policy Coherently
options.body: If nested spawning should be forbidden, update runtime config, tests, docs, and every model-facing prompt surface together.

recommendation.title: Rebase And Consolidate Guidance
recommendation.body: Keep only useful non-duplicative examples and merge them into the existing availability-aware and depth-aware prompt/tool-description surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: They opened this maintainer PR after steering the related tool-policy proposal toward prompt/scheduling behavior.
